callerObligations: Authenticate exact owned-group coverage for the same retained snapshot; well-typed data is not proof.
Carry and durably retain the entire ledger; never reset or truncate it after initialization.
Keep failed refresh, incomplete registry and any other known-group closure conditions independently fail-closed.
Provide no signaling authority through these observations; any future operations need separate fresh ownership evidence and authorization.
dataclassValidationScope: Row/container types, integer shapes and duplicate PID rejection only. These checks do not validate registry parsing, registry append-only history or full process ownership evidence.
notImplementedOrTestedHere: Parsing or rejecting malformed registry bytes/records.
Detecting a nonappend-only registry history or tampered prior entries.
Authenticating full exact ownership evidence or validating actual process identities.

outcomes.interpretation: Acceptance is conditional on a truthful caller assertion. This demonstrates the documented authentication boundary, not a valid operational admission or signaling authorization.
The helper never clears supplied taint. A stateless function cannot detect callers discarding prior history; the required entire-ledger threading and durable persistence obligations remain external.

scope: Pure helper source review and six deterministic synthetic boundary cases only; no operational integration, source modification or historical diagnosis.
